environment: Disposable embedded PostgreSQL; local Auth schema stand-in, not real email/JWT issuance

tests.name: Complete migration chain applies from a clean PostgreSQL database
Signed-out caller cannot access authenticated API
Unverified email cannot create or read trips
Trip creation is atomic and retries are idempotent
Signed-out invite preview returns only minimal safe fields
Invalid invite does not disclose trip details
Email-verified identity joins exactly once
Member cannot issue invitations
Other-trip user cannot retrieve workspace
RLS hides all unrelated trip records
Private confirmation saves one immutable revision on retry
Own brief reconstructs in a fresh database session context
Same-trip member receives status without another raw brief or ceiling
Direct private-table read is denied
Client cannot promote itself to organiser
Client cannot insert a forged trip
Cross-trip preference save is denied
Organiser cannot retrieve another member private input
Stale tab cannot overwrite a newer brief
Foreign travel-window reference is rejected
Extra actor and role fields are rejected in a brief
Overallocated stars are rejected on the server
Unacknowledged confirmation is rejected
Revoked invite cannot add a new member
Expired invite cannot add a new member
All 24 application tables have RLS enabled
